title: Hurricane Irma
description: Members of Oregon Air National Guard 125th Special Tactics Squadron and California Air National Guard 129th Rescue Wing clear airfields and assess damage in Marathon, Florida as a part of relief efforts for Hurricane Irma Sept. 11, 2017. As the largest reserve force in the Department of Defense, the National Guard has the capacity to simultaneously mitigate disaster in our local communities, and secure our national interests abroad. (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Natalie Plas)
